description: Complete ownership contract for Next.js API routes. Ordinary FastAPI JSON access uses the generated client through the JSON-only OpenAPI catch-all; non-JSON and Next-owned boundaries are explicit.

apps/dashboard/app/api/[...backendPath]/.reason: OpenAPI operation-and-method allowlisted JSON proxy for generated-client compatible dashboard calls.

apps/dashboard/app/api/auth/desktop-sign.reason: Desktop auth ticket, durable status, one-time native consumption, and acknowledgement boundary that depends on Clerk browser session context.

apps/dashboard/app/api/calendar/summary/.reason: Server-side calendar summary aggregation with analytics and model provider dependencies.

apps/dashboard/app/api/chat/habits/route.reason: Server-side AI habit parsing endpoint that uses provider credentials and compatibility behavior.

apps/dashboard/app/api/chat/sms/proactiv.reason: Proactive SMS boundary that adapts Sendblue and shared chat-runtime behavior to the provider.

apps/dashboard/app/api/chat/sms/route.ts.reason: SMS chat delivery adapter boundary for the shared chat runtime and provider response contract.

apps/dashboard/app/api/chat/stream/route.reason: Streaming chat response boundary that stays in Next for browser stream and cancellation semantics.

apps/dashboard/app/api/deepgram/token/ro.reason: Server-only short-lived Deepgram token minting endpoint for authenticated voice callers.

apps/dashboard/app/api/import/preview/ro.reason: Fixed multipart adapter for the named FastAPI import-preview operation and no other backend path.

callers: desktop Whoop and Tesla OAuth polling
apps/dashboard/app/api/integrations/oaut.reason: Temporary OAuth code bridge for desktop Whoop and Tesla polling across browser and native contexts.

apps/dashboard/app/api/integrations/tesl.reason: Third-party Tesla OAuth callback boundary that terminates in the authenticated dashboard.

apps/dashboard/app/api/integrations/whoo.reason: Third-party Whoop OAuth callback boundary that terminates in the authenticated dashboard.

apps/dashboard/app/api/internal/workflow.reason: Internal authenticated workflow execution trigger that adapts clock and queue delivery.

apps/dashboard/app/api/reports/send/rout.reason: Server-side report email dispatch boundary that retains provider credentials outside the client.

apps/dashboard/app/api/screenshot/previe.reason: Fixed multipart adapter for the named FastAPI screenshot-preview operation and no other backend path.

apps/dashboard/app/api/sendblue/webhook/.reason: External Sendblue webhook receiver with provider signature and delivery semantics.

apps/dashboard/app/api/sentry-smoke/rout.reason: Local smoke-test endpoint for frontend observability validation and no product mutation.

apps/dashboard/app/api/wearables/apple/e.reason: Fixed export adapter preserving the named FastAPI operation's JSON, text, Markdown, and CSV responses.

apps/dashboard/app/api/whisper/route.ts.reason: Server-side Whisper transcription boundary for uploaded audio and provider-held credentials.
